text: ভুট্টার জন্য বেলে দো-আঁশ ও দো-আঁশ মাটি উপযোগী এবং জমিতে পানি জমে থাকা উচিত নয়। For maize, sandy-loam and loam soils are suitable, and the field should not remain waterlogged.

text: মসুরের জন্য সুনিষ্কাশিত দো-আঁশ, বেলে দো-আঁশ বা এঁটেল দো-আঁশ মাটি উত্তম। Lentil prefers well-drained loam, sandy-loam or clay-loam soil.

For BRRI dhan29-group Boro rice with a 7.5 t/ha yield target and medium soil-test class, FRG 2024 lists nutrient ranges by element. Apply P, K, S and Zn basally; split nitrogen across establishment, early tillering and 5-7 days before panicle initiation.

For maize with an 11 t/ha yield target and medium soil-test class, FRG 2024 gives nutrient ranges by element. For Rabi maize, use one-third of nitrogen basally and the remainder at 50-55 and 80-85 days after sowing; other listed nutrients are basal.

For lentil with a 1.8 t/ha yield target and medium soil-test class, FRG 2024 gives nutrient ranges by element and applies them basally. The guide provides a Rhizobium seed-inoculation option and states that nitrogen is not needed when the inoculant is used.

For irrigated wheat with a 4.5 t/ha yield goal and medium soil-test class, FRG 2024 lists nutrient ranges by element (N 41-80, P 11-20, K 31-60, S 6-10, Mg 0-4, Zn 0-1.3, B 0-1.0 kg/ha, plus 2 t/ha organic manure). Apply two-thirds of nitrogen and all other nutrients basally at final land preparation, and the remaining one-third of nitrogen at 17-21 days after sowing following the first irrigation.

Wheat is a Rabi dry-season crop in Bangladesh, sown from November to December and harvested from March to mid-April. It is grown on well-drained upland without standing water; seed rate rises with the number of irrigations applied.
